name: Rita Chugh

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rita Chugh writes poetry in Hindi and English. Her work appears in international literary magazines and anthologies, and POP-Star Poetry lists her among its volunteer editors and publishers. Alongside poems of personal feeling, her published writing reflects on poetry itself as a way to shape and share emotion.

“ज़िन्दगी का फ़लसफ़ा” returns to a refrain of not understanding, placing love, disappointment and unspoken wishes beside one another. “Passion For Poetry” offers a more assured voice: writing becomes a source of rhythm and delight. Read together, the poems move between uncertainty about life and trust in expression.
